source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: bin/zold dispatches to the commands in lib/zold/commands, which manipulate wallets (wallet.rb, txn.rb) and remote nodes (remotes.rb). The node command launches front.rb, whose requests go through entrance.rb and pipeline.rb to farm.rb, which computes the proof of work.
